blockers.description: The frozen bootstrap task has contradictory capability ownership: MR-IMPL-BOOTSTRAP-001.task.capabilityId, contract.capabilityId, and IMPLEMENTATION_QUEUE.md identify MR-CAP-160, while task.capabilityIds, TEST-MR-BOOTSTRAP-001, and MR-CAP-001's acceptance-test contract identify MR-CAP-001. MR-CAP-160 already has primary task MR-IMPL-160 for Stable Identity Across File Movement.
blockers.whyItBlocksImplementation: Wave 0 cannot produce trustworthy task, capability, test, and release-gate receipts when the foundational support task has two incompatible authoritative owners, one of which is already owned by a different primary implementation task.
blockers.resolutionRequired: Run explicit frozen-plan change control to select and apply one bootstrap support-task capability owner consistently across IMPLEMENTATION_TASKS.jsonl, IMPLEMENTATION_QUEUE.md, implementation contracts, capability acceptance tests, dependency/ownership derivatives, and validators; then independently revalidate the full frozen authority.

blockers.description: The frozen MR-CAP-001/MR-IMPL-001 architecture proof boundary is semantically contradictory. CAPABILITY_REGISTRY.json, EXACT_LOCATION_REGISTRY.json, SYMBOL_REGISTRY.jsonl, and TEST-MR-CAP-001-UNIT-001 claim an exported TypeScript interface MR_CAP_001_CoreSymbol in Codebase/packages/frontend/core/package.json, but the hash-matching JSON manifest contains no such symbol or anchor. The contract owner path is outside the task allowed-path list, while eight actual Rspack entry source files proven by BUILD_AND_PACKAGING_MAP.md and Codebase/tools/cli/src/bundle.ts are omitted from the task exact/allowed paths. The integration test also requires undefined generic persistence behavior for a KEEP architecture capability.
blockers.whyItBlocksImplementation: MR-IMPL-001 is a prerequisite for downstream Wave 0 work, but its current authority cannot identify a truthful source owner, mutation boundary, or executable acceptance proof. Proceeding would generate receipts against a nonexistent symbol while excluding the real application entrypoints from the declared scope.
blockers.resolutionRequired: Run explicit frozen-plan change control to replace the nonexistent symbol with truthful anchors or an explicit non-symbol preservation marker; reconcile MR-CAP-001 ownership with MR-IMPL-001 exact/current/target/allowed paths and the real Rspack entry graph; classify generated dist outputs; repair the two MR-CAP-001 tests; add literal-anchor and owner/path semantic validator challenges; then run the complete change-control certification and independent review.
